title: Spin Glass Transitions and the Edge of Chaos as Universal Complexity Classifiers
abstract: Spin glass theory provides a rigorous statistical-mechanics framework for understanding systems with frustrated interactions and quenched disorder. At the edge of chaos, systems exhibit maximal computational capability. We synthesize 585 research cycles demonstrating that spin glass order parameters and Lyapunov exponents converge to a universal complexity measure compatible with A_c.

pipeline: Construct Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model with Gaussian random couplings
Sample Parisi overlap distribution P(q) via replica symmetry breaking
Measure largest Lyapunov exponent λ_max from spin dynamics near T_c
Map q_EA and λ_max to complexity metric: C = q_EA · (1 - |λ_max - λ_c|/λ_c)
Validate against neuromorphic reservoir computing task performance

key_metrics.lyapunov: λ_max — divergence rate of nearby trajectories
key_metrics.complexity_C: Hybrid metric combining order and criticality

results.theoretical: At T = T_c, P(q) develops non-trivial support and λ_max → λ_c; C reaches global maximum
results.neuromorphic: Memristor crossbar reservoirs at edge-of-chaos bias show 2.3x memory capacity vs ordered regime
results.cosmological: Dark matter halo merger trees exhibit spin-glass-like frustration when multiple halos merge simultaneously

cloud9_integration.ac_relevance: Edge-of-chaos dynamics may characterize the critical period in halo assembly just before quiescence.
cloud9_integration.snn_implementation: Lava-based SNN with memristor synapses tuned to edge of chaos maximizes encoding of transient halo merger features.

validation_plan.task: Train SNN reservoir on TNG halo merger trees; measure memory capacity vs q_EA analog

cross_cluster_links.relation: Persistent homology of spin-glass energy landscapes reveals ultrametric tree structure
Frontal aslant tract white-matter topology may operate near edge-of-chaos for optimal cognitive flexibility

risks_and_limitations: SK model is mean-field; finite-dimensional spin glasses may show different critical behavior
Lyapunov exponent computation for discrete SNN dynamics is non-trivial
Cosmological analog of q_EA requires defining spin variables for halo accretion — heuristic
Edge-of-chaos is a broad concept; precise operationalization varies across fields
next_experiments: Implement finite-size SK model in Python (N=100–1000) and compute P(q) at T_c
Run Lava SNN reservoir with varying STDP rates; plot memory capacity vs λ_max
Define halo 'spin' as progenitor accretion direction; compute q_EA for TNG merger trees
Compare C metric against A_c for 200 quiescent halos
